mapper.insert: insert into mcp_gateway ( gateway_id, gateway_name, gateway_desc, gateway_version, gateway_instructions, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{gatewayId}, #{gatewayName}, #{gatewayDesc}, #{gatewayVersion}, #{gatewayInstructions}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update mcp_gateway set gateway_id = #{gatewayId}, gateway_name = #{gatewayName}, gateway_desc = #{gatewayDesc}, gateway_version = #{gatewayVersion}, gateway_instructions = #{gatewayInstructions}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, gateway_id, gateway_name, gateway_desc, gateway_version, gateway_instructions, status, created_at, updated_at from mcp_gateway where id = #{id}
select id, gateway_id, gateway_name, gateway_desc, gateway_version, gateway_instructions, status, created_at, updated_at from mcp_gateway where gateway_id = #{gatewayId}

select id, gateway_id, gateway_name, gateway_desc, gateway_version, gateway_instructions, status, created_at, updated_at from mcp_gateway where 1 = 1 order by id desc limit #{pageSize} offset #{offset}
select id, gateway_id, gateway_name, gateway_desc, gateway_version, gateway_instructions, status, created_at, updated_at from mcp_gateway where status = 1 order by id desc
select id, gateway_id, gateway_name, gateway_desc, gateway_version, gateway_instructions, status, created_at, updated_at from mcp_gateway where 1 = 1 and status = 1 order by id desc
